footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Hovnanian Enterprises: after $12.6M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Oct 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 0.9% to $3.0B in fiscal 2025 (ended Oct 31, 2025). Operating income fell 72.9% to $86.1M, a 2.9% margin.
Net income fell 77.0% to $51.2M, or $7.43 per share. Operating cash flow was $188M and free cash flow $166M, versus $5.8M; Hovnanian Enterprises returned $40.9M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Hovnanian Enterprises, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
